provenance.dataset: Surplus Land Act Notices of Availability Received (California HCD)
provenance.license: Other (Public Domain), as stated on data.ca.gov
provenance.filter: Rows whose City is one of the 34 Orange County cities (lanes/2-clear-it/data/oc-cities.json), or whose Local Agency is an OC city, 'City of <OC city>', 'County of Orange' or an 'Orange County' agency. Rows with a blank City and a non-OC agency are not kept, so this subset can miss OC parcels.
provenance.privacy: 5 rows have address and coordinates withheld so no resident's home is pointed at: withheld when the existing use says "occupied" (not "unoccupied"), or names a house, home, dwelling, apartment or residence without saying vacant, undeveloped, unimproved or former; text about neighbouring uses is ignored. APN, agency and dates are kept. The contact column was dropped for every row. Built by apps/web/scripts/build-surplus-notices-oc.mjs.
columnsDropped: Notice Contact Information- Concatenated (personal contact details; open the notice on data.ca.gov instead)
derivedFields: dateIssued, dueDate: ISO dates parsed from MM-DD-YYYY; raw values kept
sizeAcres: first number in the size text; values marked SF or square feet divided by 43,560; null when unparseable
addressWithheld: set, and address/lon/lat blanked, by the privacy rule above
id: sla-NNN, assigned in file order
